test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: How many classical dance forms does the Sangeet Natak Akademi in India officially recognise, as of August 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**8**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Eight dance forms have been acknowledged by Sangeet Natak Akademi as classical dance forms of India as of **August 2021.**

 
 
• The classical dance form originated from the** Natya Shastra.**
 
• Classical dance has a deep-rooted relationship with the** Natya Shastra where the specific features of each of the Classical dance forms have been mentioned.**
 
• There are 8 classical dance forms in India as per the source and scholars:
 
 
• Bharatanatyam, Kathak, Kuchipudi, Odissi, Kathakali, Sattriya, Manipuri and Mohiniyattam. 
 
 
 
• The Cultural Ministry of India has included Chhau in the list of classical dances make a total of** 9 classical dance forms.**
 
• The 8 basic technicalities that are expressed in classical dance are given below:
 
 
• Shringar: Love
 
• Hasya: Humorous
 
• Karuna: Sorrow
 
• Raudra: Anger
 
• Veer: Heroism
 
• Bhayanak: Fear
 
• Bibhats: Disgust
 
• Adbhoot: Wonder
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In India, dance forms can be broadly classified into** 2 categories:**

 
 
• classical and folk dance form
 
 
 
• These dance forms have been originated from different parts of India as per the local tradition.
 
• Folk dance, on the other hand, emerged from the local tradition of the respective state, ethnic or geographic regions.
